Implementation kind Required capabilities pi.agent.v1 / pi.compact.v1 agent ['pi'] / ['pi', 'compaction'] scope.v1 / no-change.v1 check ['inert_bytes', 'read_only'] json-artifact.v1 / json-keys-guard.v1 / line-section-guard.v1 check ['inert_bytes', 'read_only'] gate.v1 / benchmark-gate.v1 check ['external_service', 'read_only'] / ['hardware_execution', 'read_only'] Role and runtime profiles Adapter choice: roleProfiles[] accepts adapter: pi (with runtimeRef and mcp) or adapter: delegated (runtimeRef: null, mcp: null). Unattended run/resume refuse delegated roles (CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED). Model selection: Configure selection (see Model configuration ); CLI --role-model overrides take precedence and persist in run.json. Runtime identity: runtimeProfiles[] locks dockerExecutable, dockerSocket, sdkIntegrity, graphDigest, imageDigest, configDigest, and profile via describePiAdapterFiles(). Context and MCP bounds Context guard (roleProfiles[].context): Enforces proven_bound or estimated_guard (lw-pi-final-json-bytes-v1), capping window bytes (<= 16 MiB), margins, and output tokens (<= 262144). MCP modes (serverId: 'workspace'): Local mode pins scriptDigest; remote HTTP mode (sessionless-http-json-v1) pins 1..4 approvedAddresses IPs to prevent DNS rebinding. Credentials and endpoints Secrets resolve exclusively in memory into a CredentialVault (vault.assertClean aborts if raw secret bytes ever serialize). ${NAME} expands in a single pass (<= 16 KiB) before TaskContract validation:
Escape & safety: Use $$ for a literal $. Shell $(...), !command, and ${NAME:-default} fail closed (CONFIG_ENV_SYNTAX). JSON Pointer allowlist: Every ${NAME} must match environmentBindings[] at that exact pointer (CONFIG_ENV_DENIED / CONFIG_ENV_MISSING): credential only under /spec/credentials/<n>/template, nonsecret under task fields. Scoped endpoints: gateEndpoints[] (consumer: gate) and publicationEndpoints[] (consumer: publisher) require https:// or loopback URLs with HMAC signingCredentialRef and optional bearer authCredentialRef. Controller controls Control field Bounds Meaning controls.drainReserveMs 5000..600000 ms (< wallTimeMs) Drain window reserved before wall-clock timeout controls.maxAttempts 1..64 Total execution and repair attempts allowed controls.repeatFailureLimit 2 Halts repair loops on identical repeated failure signature controls.submission artifact_or_assistant, path | null Candidate output source rule spec.publication disabled (default) or pull_request PR mode requires endpointRef, targetBranch, headBranchPrefix, titleTemplate Recovery Gates and reconciliation Run loopwright check or loopwright run --dry-run before execution. When an external gate or pull request call settles unknown, never replay blindly; settle with loopwright reconcile and an authenticated receipt.
Hardware binding: hardware_execution checks must bind benchmark-gate.v1 with a hardware targetCellId (CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED or CONFIG_SCHEMA otherwise). CAS staging & preemption: Controller stages blobs to the relay, pulls .loopwright-verifier/<slotId>/* (O_NOFOLLOW, 0o400), and settles exhausted preemption as blocked (BENCHMARK_PREEMPTED). Decision Routing System-One decision routing uses fast, calibrated models to classify bounded triage questions (such as capability tier selection, cycle alignment, soft compaction, or candidate diff triage). Routing is strictly advisory: deterministic controller gates and TrustedRegistry rules retain full authority over execution, verification, and publication.
Contents DecisionPolicy Confidence zones Providers and disclosure Live wiring and fallback DecisionPolicy Standalone host policy (decisions.yaml): Load a DecisionPolicy document via loadDecisionPolicyFile('decisions.yaml') (disclosurePolicy defaults to disabled). Declarative Taskpack (spec.decisions): Embed policy fields under spec.decisions in .loopwright/taskpack.yaml (enabled required; disclosurePolicy defaults to public-metadata-only). yamlCopy apiVersion: loopwright.dev/v1alpha1 kind: DecisionPolicy spec: enabled: true # Optional in standalone decisions.yaml (defaults to false) disclosurePolicy: public-metadata-only # Optional (defaults to disabled) provider: typesafe-jev # Optional (defaults to typesafe-jev) minConfidence: 0.8 # Optional (0.5..1.0, defaults to 0.8) confirmThreshold: 0.6 # Optional (0.0..minConfidence, defaults to 0.6) hardDeadlineMs: 5000 # Optional (100..30000 ms, defaults to 5000) maxAttempts: 1 # Optional (1 or 2, defaults to 1) allowImages: false # Optional (defaults to false) For declarative Taskpack triage, declare spec.decisions with optional triageRules (0..100 rules):
yamlCopy apiVersion: loopwright.dev/v1alpha1 kind: Taskpack metadata: name: docs-sync spec: # Other Taskpack sections omitted; see Taskpack. decisions: enabled: true provider: typesafe-jev # Optional disclosurePolicy: public-metadata-only # Optional minConfidence: 0.8 # Optional confirmThreshold: 0.6 # Optional triageRules: # Optional pre-publication candidate diff rules (0..100) - id: docs-only-risk description: Flag risky config edits outside expected doc files. severity: important kind: noul threshold: 0.7 # Optional finite score in 0.0..1.0 Threshold order: Policies with confirmThreshold > minConfidence fail closed (DECISION_POLICY_INVALID). Question primitives: Programmatic callers compose choice (<= 255 options), score (2..10 criteria), noul (0.0..1.0), and box (allowImages: true). Confidence zones Every calibrated response routes into one of three deterministic zones:
Zone Confidence range Router action act confidence >= minConfidence Accepts the advisory choice within bounded non-authority scope confirm confirmThreshold <= confidence < minConfidence Requests secondary confirmation or conservative check escalate confidence < confirmThreshold (or timeout/error) Rejects model advice and runs deterministic fallback Providers and disclosure Providers Provider Wire dialect Default model Secret variable typesafe-jev systemone jev-latest TYPESAFE_API_KEY openai-decisions openai-decisions gpt-6-luna OPENAI_API_KEY startlux-decision systemone startlux-decision-27b-autothink STARTLUX_API_KEY microsoft-decision systemone microsoft-decision-1 MICROSOFT_DECISION_API_KEY perplexity-decider systemone pplx-decider-v1.2 PERPLEXITY_API_KEY cloudflare-clef systemone @cf/cloudflare/clef CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN liquid-d1 systemone liquid/d1-ultra LIQUID_API_KEY Disclosure policies Policy Outbound payload ceiling Security rule disabled 0 bytes (no network call) Blocks all outbound provider requests public-metadata-only Redacted metadata (<= 512 chars) Strips raw file contents, diffs, and secrets repo-approved-redacted-evidence Secret-scrubbed evidence (<= 64 KiB) Requires explicit operator approval for repository snippets Live wiring and fallback Both the GitHub Action and CLI inject live @loopwright/decisions adapters through ControllerPorts.decisions (AdvisoryDecisionPort) covering capability routing, cycle alignment, soft compaction, candidate diff triage, and evolutionary novelty/strategy/cascade hooks.
Advisory stamps: Every decision stamps advisoryOnly: true and verificationCertified: false. Deterministic fallback: Missing credentials, timeouts, or unreachable endpoints fall back deterministically (deterministic_fallback / deterministic_heuristic) without blocking runs. Non-delegable authority: Forbidden intents (granting authority, certifying evidence, skipping review, approving gates, overriding pinned models, or vetoing hard compaction) throw DECISION_AUTHORITY_VIOLATION. See also — Taskpack (embed spec.decisions in .loopwright/taskpack.yaml) · Controller and Registry (deterministic controller authority)

Evolution Campaign EvolutionCampaign (<= 64 KiB) defines a bounded multi-generation search over a repository Taskpack, an isolated campaign.sqlite Pareto archive, and signed evolution-bundle.v1 exports. Loopwright binds each candidate to an isolated child LocalRunStore and never lets models self-certify hardware results.
For an end-to-end setup walkthrough, follow Evolutionary Campaign . For TaskContract hardware target cells and threshold rules, see Task Contract .
Contents EvolutionCampaign Stages and population Sampling and budgets Plateau team evolution Bundle export contract EvolutionCampaign yamlCopy apiVersion: loopwright.dev/v1alpha1 kind: EvolutionCampaign metadata: name: flash-decode-sm90a spec: taskpack: .loopwright/taskpack.yaml targetCellId: cuda-h100-whole tracks: # Optional - triton - cute - cuda_raw stages: # Optional mode: specialist-then-portfolio # Optional specialistBuckets: - id: bs1-isl4k heldOutWorkloadId: decode-bs1-4k - id: bs16-isl8k heldOutWorkloadId: decode-bs16-8k portfolioHeldOutWorkloadId: decode-portfolio-holdout population: islands: 4 migrationIntervalGenerations: 8 maxMigrationElites: 1 nicheAxes: - id: bound_pipeline kind: enum values: - hbm - l2 - smem_lds_ub - tensor_cube - vector_valu - id: occupancy_band kind: numeric_bins edges: - 0 - 25 - 50 - 75 - 100 sampling: noveltyDecayLambda: 1.0 mutationWeights: diff_tune: 0.5 full_rewrite: 0.3 crossover: 0.2 modelBandit: ucb1 # Optional maxCrossoversPerPrompt: 2 teamEvolution: # Optional enabled: true supervisorRoleId: supervisor allowedArchetypeRoles: - probe-readonly - mutator-sandboxed - reviewer stallGenerations: 4 # Optional minHypervolumeDelta: 0.001 # Optional triggerOnRunEvalPathology: true # Optional trialGenerations: 2 # Optional maxTeamSize: 3 # Optional maxTeamSteps: 4 # Optional objectives: - metric: latency_us_p50 direction: minimize - metric: goodput_rps direction: maximize budgets: maxGenerations: 40 maxEvaluations: 160 maxConcurrentEvaluations: 4 targetRooflineHeadroom: 1.08 # Optional scratchpadIntervalGenerations: 5 # Optional export: # Optional format: oci-layout # Optional outputDir: .loopwright-out/bundles/flash-decode-sm90a Stages and population Campaigns optimize either one target workload (single-target) or bucket-specialized kernels merged into a verified dispatcher (specialist-then-portfolio):
Taskpack & cell binding: spec.taskpack must point to a repository taskpack whose target.matrix declares spec.targetCellId. Holdout isolation: In specialist-then-portfolio, portfolioHeldOutWorkloadId must differ from every specialist heldOutWorkloadId and never enters specialist prompts. Ring-topology islands: 1..16 islands maintain independent MAP-Elites archives and migrate rank-1 elites clockwise every migrationIntervalGenerations. Niche projection: 1..4 nicheAxes[] (enum or numeric_bins) map observed metrics or hardware diagnostics into discrete cells. Sampling and budgets Loopwright selects parents with novelty decay, screens clones before hardware dispatch, and ranks passing candidates via NSGA-II:
Pre-dispatch novelty gate: Normalized token-shingle clones (Jaccard === 1.0) fail fast with NOVELTY_CLONE_REJECTED and zero hardware calls. Model routing: sampling.modelBandit selects deterministic-round-robin (default) or ucb1 across declared taskpack models. Preemption accounting: Hardware BENCHMARK_PREEMPTED outcomes never consume maxEvaluations and never poison bandit rewards. Roofline early stop: Optional targetRooflineHeadroom (>= 1.0) stops search once observed hardware headroom reaches the declared bound. Plateau team evolution Optional spec.teamEvolution invokes a read-only supervisor role only when an island stalls (stallGenerations, minHypervolumeDelta) or hits RunEval loop pathology:
Archetype ceiling: Supervisor TeamPatch outputs may only recompose roles within allowedArchetypeRoles tool and network ceilings (maxTeamSize: 1..4, maxTeamSteps: 1..6). Zero-mutation supervisor: Runs in an isolated read-only LocalRunStore (no_change verified) with zero repo write tools. Trial rollback: Trial teams auto-rollback after trialGenerations without Pareto or niche gain; malformed patches keep the incumbent active. Bundle export contract Optional spec.export (or loopwright evolve export) writes deterministic, content-addressed evolution-bundle.v1 directories or OCI 1.1 layouts:
Fail-closed verification: Export refuses missing HMAC secrets, tampered CAS blobs, incompatible hardware provenance, or unopted synthetic_fixture receipts (EXPORT_UNVERIFIED_FORBIDDEN). Atomic staging: Bundles stage into a sibling non-symlink directory and rename atomically (EVOLUTION_CONFLICT on collision without --overwrite). Bundle member Format Role manifest.json kind: EvolutionBundle, version: 1 Hardware compatibility, Pareto summary, lineage, and member digests dispatch-manifest.json version: 1, fallback: baseline Bucket routing rules (dimensionBounds, dtypes, blobDigest, entrypoint) receipts/<id>.verdict.json Signed benchmark_verdict JSON Verbatim HMAC-signed hardware verdict receipts blobs/sha256/<hex> Verified Stage A CAS blobs Compiled .cubin, .so, .o, or .ptx artifacts See also — Evolutionary Campaign (end-to-end setup and loopwright evolve walkthrough) · Task Contract (hardware target cells, thresholds, and provenance) · CLI (runner and evolve subcommands)

Sandbox Backends Sandbox policy negotiates OS or container isolation before any agent step runs. When available host backends cannot satisfy your requested capabilities or network policy, negotiation fails closed (SANDBOX_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE or SANDBOX_CAPABILITY_INSUFFICIENT).
Contents Sandbox policy Policy fields Backend choices Network and capabilities Host qualification Sandbox policy Declarative Taskpack mode: Declare spec.sandbox inside .loopwright/taskpack.yaml. The GitHub Action or App negotiates a matching host backend automatically. Managed Controller mode: Pin container/runtime identities in TrustedRegistry.spec.runtimeProfiles[] (see Controller and Registry ) and pass SandboxPolicyInput when invoking native host sandbox wrappers. yamlCopy apiVersion: loopwright.dev/v1alpha1 kind: Taskpack metadata: name: docs-sync spec: # Other Taskpack sections omitted; see Taskpack. sandbox: # Optional host isolation policy preferredBackends: # Optional priority order - macos-seatbelt - linux-bwrap - linux-landlock - docker networkMode: none # Optional (defaults to none) requiredCapabilities: # Optional - filesystemReadContainment - filesystemWriteContainment - protectedPathReadOnlyMask - networkIsolation - processTreeCleanup deniedReadPaths: # Optional extra host paths masked unreadable - ~/.ssh - ~/.aws - ~/.config/gh Priority order: Loopwright probes preferredBackends in order and picks the first backend supporting every listed requiredCapabilities item. Declared policy: Omitting networkMode in an explicit sandbox policy defaults to none. Neutral built-in masks: Local sandboxes protect .git, <controlRoot>, scope.protected, and deniedReadPaths. GitHub runs also mask .github unless .github/workflows/** is dual-key unlocked. Read-only bind mounts: Linux bwrap and docker use readOnlyBindMounts for mountReadOnlyGit, while Seatbelt and Landlock copy .git/objects read-only via 1 MiB streaming. When GITHUB_ACTIONS=true, RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT=github-hosted, and spec.sandbox is omitted, resolveEffectiveTaskpackSandboxPolicy selects direct-dedicated. It sets allow-outbound, requires processTreeCleanup, and enables allowDedicatedDirectOverride. GitHub-hosted runner VMs isolate single jobs, whereas direct execution adds no filesystem or network masks. Self-hosted Actions runners (where RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT is not github-hosted) stay on OS sandbox negotiation.
The turnkey host session supports macos-seatbelt, linux-bwrap, linux-landlock, and direct-dedicated, and blocks docker.
Outside GitHub-hosted Actions runners, an omitted policy selects fail-closed macos-seatbelt, linux-bwrap, or linux-landlock negotiation.
Policy fields spec.sandbox itself is optional inside Taskpack, and every subfield inside spec.sandbox is also optional:
Field path Required Default and bounds Meaning spec.sandbox No Unset Optional sandbox declaration block in Taskpack sandbox.preferredBackends No Host default order (1..5 unique) Ordered candidate backends probed on the execution host sandbox.networkMode No 'none' ('none', 'loopback-only', 'allow-outbound') Socket policy enforced at the OS or container boundary sandbox.requiredCapabilities No Unset (0..6 unique) Isolation guarantees that the chosen backend must provide sandbox.deniedReadPaths No Unset (0..64 entries) Host or ~/-relative paths blocked from read access Backend choices Configure spec.sandbox.preferredBackends[] in priority order:
Backend Isolation mechanism Host prerequisite macos-seatbelt macOS Seatbelt profile (sandbox-exec) Qualified macOS host with /usr/bin/sandbox-exec linux-bwrap Linux namespaces and seccomp (bwrap) Qualified Linux host with /usr/bin/bwrap linux-landlock Linux Landlock LSM rules Linux kernel with Landlock ABI support docker Rootless or daemon container Qualified Docker binary and verified daemon socket direct-dedicated Disposable dedicated runner Actions default for omitted policy; otherwise explicit host opt-in; no filesystem/network masks Network and capabilities Network modes Mode Traffic policy Constraint none Blocks all outbound and loopback sockets Default for an explicit policy without networkMode loopback-only Permits 127.0.0.1 and ::1 traffic only Used for local loopback MCP or runner bridges allow-outbound Permits outbound network connections Actions omitted-policy default or explicit policy opt-in Sandbox capabilities Capability Protection boundary Supporting backends filesystemReadContainment Restricts reads outside workspace and deniedReadPaths Seatbelt, bubblewrap, Landlock, Docker filesystemWriteContainment Restricts writes strictly to candidate writable paths Seatbelt, bubblewrap, Landlock, Docker protectedPathReadOnlyMask Mounts or masks protected paths read-only Seatbelt, bubblewrap, Landlock, Docker networkIsolation Enforces networkMode at kernel or container level Seatbelt, bubblewrap, Landlock, Docker processTreeCleanup Terminates all descendant processes on step exit All five backends syscallFiltering Applies seccomp or container syscall filter profile Bubblewrap and Docker Host qualification Live observations Local fixture checks do not qualify a production host. Before relying on a backend in CI or production, verify the host OS/architecture (darwin/arm64, linux/arm64, linux/x64), installed sandbox binaries, and kernel user-namespace or Landlock support.
Limits and costs Resource limits, timeouts, and token consumption depend on the approved RuntimeProfile and TaskContract.spec.budgets envelope.
See also — Taskpack (embed spec.sandbox in .loopwright/taskpack.yaml) · Controller and Registry (pin runtimeProfiles in registry.yaml)

Task Contract TaskContract defines what bounded work is requested, where files may change, how much time and model budget a run may spend, and which independent checks must pass. Declarative Taskpack mode compiles TaskContract automatically; Managed Controller mode embeds it inside ControllerConfig while keeping credentials and handler digests in TrustedRegistry (see Configuration relationships ).
Contents TaskContract Scope and context Roles and steps Budgets and enforcement Acceptance and evidence Hardware target cells TaskContract yamlCopy apiVersion: loopwright.dev/v1alpha1 kind: TaskContract spec: goal: Update packages/app/manifest.json release metadata and pass verification. taskpack: app-manifest target: repository: acme/example-app baseRevision: 67a4938 sourceRevision: v1.4.0 matrix: null # Optional matrix cell list (use null for controller runs) scope: writable: - "packages/app/**" protected: - "packages/app/policy/**" roles: - id: builder adapter: pi provider: zai model: glm-5.3 thinking: high tools: - read - write - edit trustedContext: revision: rev-2026-11 discovery: disabled resources: # Optional pinned context files (use [] when unused) - id: release-guide kind: instruction path: context/release-guide.md digest: algorithm: sha256 hex: <hash> when: # Optional deterministic activation predicates changedPaths: # Optional - "packages/app/**" phases: # Optional - author - repair budgets: wallTimeMs: 300000 totalTokens: 64000 perCallOutputTokens: 1024 maxModelCalls: 8 maxConcurrency: 1 maxFormatRepairs: 1 maxImplementationRepairs: 2 maxTransportRetries: 1 enforcement: wallTime: hard_admission tokens: soft_accounting modelCalls: hard_admission concurrency: hard_admission formatRepairs: hard_admission implementationRepairs: hard_admission transportRetries: hard_admission steps: - id: author-change kind: agent uses: pi-author roleId: builder dependsOn: [] - id: review-change kind: agent uses: pi-review roleId: builder dependsOn: - author-change handoffs: # Optional 1..16 compact ancestor extracts - id: author-summary # Optional fromStep: author-change source: kind: submission select: kind: json_pointer pointers: - /summary maxBytes: 8192 # Optional required: true # Optional - id: verify-manifest kind: check uses: check-manifest-json roleId: null # Optional on schema; null for check steps dependsOn: - review-change acceptance: required: - manifest-json checks: - id: manifest-json allowedEvidenceLevels: - local_execution Zero embedded authority: TaskContract cannot approve handler code, environment variables, network endpoints, or credentials. Strict schema (<= 1 MiB): Every required spec key must appear explicitly (null or [] when empty); unknown keys fail FIELD_UNKNOWN. Canonical identity: Loopwright hashes TaskContract via RFC 8785 JCS (taskByteDigest), so any edit changes run identity. Scope and context Writable vs protected: scope.writable (1..128 globs) allows edits; scope.protected (0..128 globs) always overrides writable. Pinned context: trustedContext.discovery is fixed to 'disabled'; every resources[] entry (0..128, <= 1 MiB total) pins a SHA-256 digest matching TrustedRegistry. Conditional activation rules resources[].when filters pre-hashed context per dispatch without runtime discovery. Specified fields combine with AND, and values inside each list combine with OR:
Predicate field Values and matching changedPaths 1..128 globs matching candidate diffs or initial watchedPaths extensions 1..64 lowercase .ext suffixes matching changed files phases author, review, repair, rework (format mounts zero conditional rules) failedChecks / failureCodes 1..64 failed check IDs or verifier failure reason codes Roles and steps Roles (1..64): Bind adapter (pi or delegated), provider, model, thinking, tools, and optional resourceIds (see Model configuration ). Steps (1..256 acyclic nodes): agent steps bind a roleId; check steps set roleId: null. Optional onRework: { rejectTo, maxReworks } resets an ancestor (1..8 times). Handoff selectors steps[].handoffs[] (1..16 entries, <= 65536 bytes per step) mounts read-only (0o400) extracts with sourceSha256 and extractSha256 provenance from a strict DAG ancestor fromStep:
Selector field Values and behavior fromStep Strict DAG ancestor steps[].id (GRAPH_CYCLE / REFERENCE_UNKNOWN otherwise) source.kind 'artifact' (<= 1 MiB epoch file), 'submission', or 'verdict' select.kind 'markdown_heading' (fence-aware), 'json_pointer' (1..32 RFC 6901 pointers), or 'full' maxBytes / required 64..65536 bytes (default 8192); fails closed when required: true (default) Budgets and enforcement Every retry and repair draws from one parent budgets envelope (wallTimeMs must exceed controls.drainReserveMs; child caps exceeding parent ceilings fail BUDGET_INCONSISTENT). Optional budgets.overlay raises candidate overlay limits from 128 files / 4 MiB up to 16,384 files / 16 GiB.
Enforcement mode Admission behavior Dimensions hard_admission Pre-reserves quota in SQLite before dispatch; refuses insufficient allowance wallTime, modelCalls, concurrency, formatRepairs, implementationRepairs, transportRetries soft_accounting Records actual post-call usage and halts further calls once reached tokens (exact output count is known post-generation) Acceptance and evidence spec.acceptance.required lists every check ID that must pass. Admission selects classic { entries } ArtifactManifest only for small baselines (<= 128 files / <= 4 MiB); otherwise it uses tree_overlay (<= 65,536 baseline files, CAS blob pointers) with a separate verifier output budget for .loopwright-verifier/<slotId>/*.
Evidence level Observation source Qualification boundary static_inspection Deterministic byte or AST parser Inert file inspection only; executes no target code synthetic_fixture Controlled local test fixture Proves harness logic only; never qualifies live systems local_execution Isolated host verifier worker Scoped to current host (json-artifact.v1, scope.v1, command.v1) external_service Signed gate.v1 remote receipt Requires trusted gateEndpoints[] URL and HMAC secret hardware_execution Dedicated physical target runner Must appear alone as ['hardware_execution'] with benchmark-gate.v1 Hardware target cells Each spec.target.matrix[] cell accepts an optional hardware block (accelerator, isolationMode: 'whole_device' | 'sliced', optional deviceCount, driverConstraint, topology, and Stage A static audit limits forbiddenSymbolPatterns, maxRegisterCount, maxLocalSpillBytes).
Metric thresholds: metricThresholds[] (0..32) enforces bounds or comparative (min_ratio/max_ratio/max_delta) rules across optional bucketScope. Physical provenance: hardware_execution requires hardwareProvenance with probeKind: 'physical' unless allowSyntheticHardwareProbe: true, failing closed on mismatch (hardware_provenance_mismatch, metric_threshold_failed). Taskpack Taskpack powers Loopwright’s automated mode in a bounded YAML document (<= 64 KiB, .loopwright/taskpack.yaml). For out-of-repo TrustedRegistry governance or CLI controller files, see Task Contract and Controller and Registry .
Contents Compilation model Taskpack Execution and scope Preflight and upstreams Roles and steps Model configuration Verification and publication TaskpackSuite Compilation model When loopwright run --taskpack, loopwright step, the GitHub Action, or the GitHub App runs a taskpack, the compiler generates three runtime artifacts:

Under mode: strict, enabling privileged capabilities (allowHostEnv, allowHostPath, mountReadOnlyGit, allowCheckNetwork, allowAgentNetwork) requires allow-privileged-execution: 'true' (--allow-privileged).
Workflow & mount unlocks: allowWorkflowWrites requires --allow-workflow-writes; command.v1 mounts[] requires privileged authority plus --allow-host-mounts. Static interpolation (spec.vars): Replaces ${VAR} in allowlisted fields only; undeclared or secret ${...} expressions fail (TASKPACK_UNTRUSTED_INTERPOLATION). Explicit path globs: Write dir/** for recursive directories and exact paths or */? globs for files; protected always wins over writable. Conditional instructions: instructions and skills accept { path, when } predicates (see Task Contract ) pre-hashed under discovery: 'disabled'. Policy profiles: Local runs protect .git, <controlRoot>, and digests.lock.json; GitHub runs also protect .github. Preflight and upstreams spec.preflight runs once on the host after actor authorization and SecretScrubber setup, writing { disposition, upstreams, stagedResources } JSON to $LOOPWRIGHT_PREFLIGHT_OUT.
Split staged resources: mount: 'prompt' (<= 64 KiB UTF-8) injects context text; mount: 'workspace' (<= 128 MiB, single-link regular files) stages read-only files and optional $LOOPWRIGHT_STAGED_DIR check inputs. Lockstep groups: Declare spec.upstreamGroups[] (policy: lockstep) so partial or mismatched releases resolve atomically as held_back. Upstream kind Typical target Guardrail github-release GitHub Releases allowPrerelease defaults false git-tag / git-commit Tags or watched repo paths watchedPaths (0..64) feeds intake context http-json JSON catalogs and registries versionPath + monotonicSemver (default true) custom-table Repository version matrix Keep source table outside scope.writable Roles and steps spec.roles[]: Declares 1..16 roles (task or review) with provider, model, tools, instructions, skills, mcpServers, and fallback models. Review roles default tools to ['read'] and mcpServers to []. spec.steps[]: Declares 1..16 acyclic agent, check, or compact nodes with dependsOn, compact handoffs (1..16; see Task Contract ), and optional onRework: { rejectTo, maxReworks }. Model configuration spec.models[] (1..8 items; defaults zai / glm-5.3 / high) supports token-authenticated Pi HTTP providers and custom baseUrl gateways (allow-custom-base-url: 'true'). Interactive OAuth/CLI providers and OAuth MCP servers fail closed (PROVIDER_OAUTH_UNSUPPORTED, MCP_OAUTH_UNSUPPORTED).
Execution limits Precedence is Action with: inputs > spec.limits > LOOPWRIGHT_* environment variables > compiler defaults. Key defaults and caps: wallTimeSeconds (3600, 60..21600), totalTokens (20000000), maxModelCalls (256), maxAttempts (5, 1..16), maxTurns / maxRepairTurns (1..1024), and limits.overlay (default 128 files / 4 MiB, up to 16,384 files / 16 GiB via 1 MiB CAS streaming).

GitHub runs enforce triggers pre-preflight and support all four memory.apply modes. Isolation & triage: Configure spec.sandbox (Sandbox Backends ) and spec.decisions (Decision Routing ). Stateless readiness: Stage probes read versionFrom blobs (<= 1 MiB) from baseRevision and emit eligible or deferred. content:
Architecture Loopwright runs bounded repository work inside isolated sandboxes and verifies every candidate against independent evidence. Choose declarative taskpacks, out-of-repo managed controllers, or multi-generation evolutionary campaigns on one verification kernel.
Contents Execution chain Operating modes Configuration surfaces Runtime baseline Trust boundaries Execution chain Admit: Validate task boundaries and acquire a monotonic SQLite lease fence. Execute: Run an isolated Pi or delegated role with trusted bindings and optional decision routing. Verify: Evaluate the candidate against independent checks and authenticated gate receipts. Publish & Remember: Settle pull request publication and propose reviewed memory separately. Operating modes Loopwright supports three operating modes sharing one fenced verification kernel:
Dimension Declarative taskpack Managed controller Evolutionary campaign Target user Repo maintainers and CLI users Platform and security operators Kernel and benchmark engineers Files authored .loopwright/taskpack.yaml Out-of-repo registry.yaml + controller.yaml .loopwright/taskpack.yaml + campaign.yaml Digest pinning Compiled automatically by host Pinned manually (--registry-sha256) Compiled per isolated child run Execution model Compiled author + check pipeline Custom multi-step agent and check DAG Island Pareto search over EVOLVE-BLOCK spans Credential wiring Mapped from CLI, Action, or App env Explicit credentialBindings templates Relay HMAC and provider env secrets Walkthrough Declarative Taskpack Managed Controller Evolutionary Campaign Configuration surfaces Every Loopwright document uses apiVersion: loopwright.dev/v1alpha1 across all configuration surfaces:
Mode or scope Document kind Top-level keys Owning page Declarative mode Taskpack / TaskpackSuite apiVersion, kind, metadata.name, spec Taskpack Managed mode TrustedRegistry apiVersion, kind, metadata.name, spec Controller and Registry Managed mode ControllerConfig apiVersion, kind, spec Controller and Registry Managed mode TaskContract apiVersion, kind, spec Task Contract Shared policy spec.sandbox Nested under Taskpack.spec Sandbox Backends Shared policy DecisionPolicy apiVersion, kind, spec Decision Routing Evolution mode EvolutionCampaign apiVersion, kind, metadata.name, spec Evolution Campaign Entry points Action or GitHubAppConfig Workflow or apiVersion, kind, spec GitHub Action · GitHub App Runtime baseline Deployment host qualification (qualifyDeploymentHostProfile) enforces these baseline prerequisites across Action, App, and CLI surfaces:
Component Baseline requirement Enforcement scope Node runtime Node.js 26.x (built-in node:sqlite) Required across Action, App, CLI, and workspace builds Package manager npm 11.x Workspace dependency installation and builds Host platform darwin/arm64, linux/arm64, linux/x64 Unlisted OS or architecture targets fail closed Storage and clock Local POSIX filesystem; <= 1000 ms drift Network mounts (nfs, smb, fuse, sshfs) and clock jumps fail closed Sandbox backend Seatbelt, bubblewrap, Landlock, or Docker Negotiated against taskpack spec.sandbox policy Optional tools Python 3.11+ (runner); Hugo 0.170.1+ Needed only for runner helpers or site builds Trust boundaries Trusted hosts bind credentials, runtimes, handlers, and external services. Taskpacks and model output cannot grant authority. Local runs protect .git and <controlRoot> while GitHub entrypoints enforce triggers, PR publication, and .github/workflows/** dual-key locks.
Large overlays stream through SHA-256 verified CAS blob pointers (1 MiB chunks, up to 16,384 files and 16 GiB) instead of inline base64 buffers. Local fixture proof never establishes live provider qualification, and unknown external effects stay unknown until reconciled.

content:
Installation Run Loopwright as a zero-install GitHub Action in target repositories or install the @gpustack/loopwright CLI on a macOS or Linux laptop. After setup, paste a single bootstrap prompt into your coding agent to initialize or migrate repository configuration interactively.
Contents Entry points Prerequisites Step 1: Install CLI Step 2: Verify CLI GitHub Actions Prompt bootstrap Entry points Surface Operating mode Installation method GitHub Action Declarative Taskpack (Simple) Zero local setup; reference uses: gpustack/loopwright@main Host coding agent (loopwright step) Delegated Taskpack or Controller Install @gpustack/loopwright and follow Coding Agents Laptop CLI (npm / pnpm) Managed Controller or local audit npm install -g --ignore-scripts @gpustack/loopwright or pnpm add -g --ignore-scripts @gpustack/loopwright Release tarball Pinned or air-gapped hosts Install gpustack-loopwright-<version>.tgz from GitHub Releases Source checkout Contributors and testers Clone repository, run npm ci && npm run build, and run npm link Prerequisites Local CLI and app-serve hosts must satisfy the runtime baseline : Node.js 26.x (with built-in node:sqlite), npm 11.x, and a local POSIX filesystem on darwin/arm64, linux/arm64, or linux/x64. Provision an approved sandbox backend before executing isolated agent steps.
Step 1: Install CLI npm package Install @gpustack/loopwright globally from npmjs.com using npm or pnpm. Pass --ignore-scripts to skip optional transitive lifecycle scripts.
shCopy npm install -g --ignore-scripts @gpustack/loopwright # or with pnpm: pnpm add -g --ignore-scripts @gpustack/loopwright Run one-off commands without a global install using npx or pnpm dlx:
shCopy npx --ignore-scripts @gpustack/loopwright --help # or with pnpm: pnpm --ignore-scripts dlx @gpustack/loopwright --help Each release publishes from GitHub Actions via npm Trusted Publishers with signed SLSA build provenance.
Release archive Install an immutable release archive from GitHub Releases and verify its matching .sha256 checksum (replace 0.0.3 with your target version):
shCopy npm install -g --ignore-scripts https://github.com/gpustack/loopwright/releases/download/v0.0.3/gpustack-loopwright-0.0.3.tgz Source build Clone the repository to develop locally or test unreleased commits:
shCopy git clone https://github.com/gpustack/loopwright.git cd loopwright npm ci npm run build npm link Step 2: Verify CLI Confirm the binary resolves on your PATH:
shCopy loopwright --version loopwright --help For Managed Controller runs, loopwright init --directory "$HOME/loopwright-ops" writes low-level controller.draft.yaml and registry.draft.yaml skeletons (0600). To initialize a repository .loopwright/taskpack.yaml or migrate existing sync scripts without manual boilerplate, use the interactive bootstrap prompt below.
GitHub Actions Consumer repositories using Declarative Taskpack mode do not need local CLI installation. Add .loopwright/taskpack.yaml and reference gpustack/loopwright@main in .github/workflows/loopwright.yml:
yamlCopy name: loopwright on: workflow_dispatch: {} permissions: contents: read jobs: taskpack: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: gpustack/loopwright@main with: taskpack-path: .loopwright/taskpack.yaml event-name: ${{ github.event_name }} event-path: ${{ github.event_path }} dry-run: 'true' The composite Action provisions Node.js 26 automatically on the runner. Follow GitHub Action for App token wiring and secret bindings.
Prompt bootstrap No custom skill or plugin is required to author Loopwright YAML. Open your coding agent inside the target repository (for example, when migrating an existing automatic synchronized workflow) and paste one prompt:
Taskpack prompt textCopy Read https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/llms.txt and its Bootstrap Interview Reference (https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/references/bootstrap-interview.md). Inspect this repository first WITHOUT editing any files yet, then interview me one question at a time with repository-grounded defaults to agree on which modules to automate or exclude, domain boundaries, update cadence, version/promotion holds, bounded host preflight -> offline sandbox -> independent verifier design, model pool (LOOPWRIGHT_PROVIDER_TOKEN), and workflow panel. Wait for my approval on the design summary before generating Loopwright config (apiVersion: loopwright.dev/v1alpha1) and running dry-run verification. Controller prompt textCopy Read https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/llms.txt and its Bootstrap Interview Reference (https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/references/bootstrap-interview.md). Inspect this repository first WITHOUT editing any files yet, then interview me one question at a time with repository-grounded defaults to align on writable/protected scope, budgets, verification checks, and role bindings. Wait for my approval on the design summary before computing local Loopwright handler and graph SHA-256 digests, writing out-of-repo registry.yaml and controller.yaml, and validating with loopwright check. Evolution prompt textCopy Read https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/llms.txt and its Bootstrap Interview Reference (https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/references/bootstrap-interview.md). Inspect this repository first WITHOUT editing any files yet, then follow Evolutionary campaign mode (Mode 3) to interview me one question at a time with repository-grounded defaults on EVOLVE-BLOCK guarded files, target hardware cell and Stage A static audit limits, held-out benchmark-gate.v1 workloads and runner relay/worker topology, objectives, island/niche budgets, optional teamEvolution, and bundle export. Wait for my approval on the design summary before generating .loopwright/taskpack.yaml and .loopwright/campaign.yaml and validating with loopwright evolve check. content:
CLI The CLI validates trusted configuration, syncs taskpack digest lockfiles, and manages bounded local runs. Install loopwright first via Installation , then use it to prepare, run, inspect, reconcile, or audit capability closure.
Contents Step 1: Prepare and check Step 2: Execute runs Step 3: Inspect and recover Step 4: Audit closure Delegated stepping Suites and App Runner and evolution Exit codes Step 1: Prepare and check Scaffold Managed Controller drafts outside the checkout (controller.draft.yaml, registry.draft.yaml, README.draft.md), pin digests.lock.json for Taskpacks, and compile statically:
shCopy loopwright init --directory ./loopwright-config loopwright digest sync --taskpack .loopwright/taskpack.yaml --repo . --check --json loopwright check --config CONFIG --registry REGISTRY --registry-sha256 DIGEST --json loopwright run --dry-run --taskpack .loopwright/taskpack.yaml --repo . --json Drafts: Replace REVIEW_REQUIRED placeholders and compute the approved registry.yaml SHA-256 before running check. For repository Taskpacks, use the bootstrap prompt . Digest lockfile: digest sync hashes preflight.script, command.v1 directories, instructions, and skills (DIGEST_LOCKFILE_DRIFT, exit 4 on drift). Static check: check and run --dry-run perform zero preflight, model, or publication calls; managed run --dry-run refuses privilege flags. Step 2: Execute runs Run a local Taskpack, launch a Managed Controller cycle, or resume an existing run under identical trusted bindings:
shCopy loopwright run --taskpack .loopwright/taskpack.yaml --repo REPO --run-root TRUSTED_ROOT --run-id demo loopwright run --config CONFIG --registry REGISTRY --registry-sha256 DIGEST --repo REPO --run-root TRUSTED_ROOT --run-id demo loopwright resume --config CONFIG --registry REGISTRY --registry-sha256 DIGEST --repo REPO --run-root TRUSTED_ROOT --run-id demo Local taskpack mode: --taskpack accepts --mode, --baseline-alignment, --source-revision, and --role-model. PR publication or PR memory fails closed locally (TASKPACK_HOST_BINDING_INVALID). Dual-key privileges: run, resume, step next, and step submit accept --allow-privileged and --allow-workflow-writes; run and step also accept --allow-host-mounts <csv>. Diagnostics & decisions: --output-format (json, github-step-summary, markdown, text) and --step-summary-file emit RunEval. Enabled spec.decisions wires live adapters with fallback. Step 3: Inspect and recover shCopy loopwright status --run-root TRUSTED_ROOT --run-id demo --json loopwright inspect --run-root TRUSTED_ROOT --run-id demo --output INSPECTION_DIR --json loopwright reconcile --config CONFIG --registry REGISTRY --registry-sha256 DIGEST --repo REPO --run-root TRUSTED_ROOT --run-id demo --receipt RECEIPT --json Inspect state and run-eval.json offline before recovery. Settle any unknown external outcome with its matching authenticated receipt via reconcile; never silently retry uncertain remote effects.
Step 4: Audit closure shCopy loopwright closure --verify-failures --json Closure audits the 23-capability matrix and 14-case failure suite, exiting 0 when valid, 3 on unsupported/falsified capability, 4 on failure-matrix failure, and 8 on integrity failure.
Disposition Evidence scope Meaning closed_local Recorded local evidence Local criterion and failure matrix passed blocked_external Unprovisioned external service Live provider, host, or hardware remains external deferred_owned Deferred owned capability Recorded prerequisite remains unimplemented Delegated stepping Hand delegated roles to host coding agents (see Coding Agents for the full coroutine loop and overlay application):
shCopy loopwright step next --taskpack .loopwright/taskpack.yaml --repo REPO --run-root TRUSTED_ROOT --run-id demo --json loopwright step submit --run-root TRUSTED_ROOT --run-id demo --lease TOKEN --status completed --json loopwright step cancel --run-root TRUSTED_ROOT --run-id demo --json Leases & recovery: Submit each single-use --lease token once (--status completed|no_change|failed|blocked, optional --submission-file or --reason). Pass --reissue-lease to rotate a lost lease on a parked run. Model overrides: check, run, resume, and step next accept up to 8 repeatable --role-model ROLE=PROVIDER/MODEL[:THINKING] entries (argv <= 64). Suites and App Suite commands Validate multi-domain TaskpackSuite manifests and resolve GitHub Actions matrices or comment commands offline:
shCopy loopwright suite check --suite .loopwright/suite.yaml --repo . --verify-digests --json loopwright suite resolve --suite .loopwright/suite.yaml --repo . --event schedule --schedule nightly --json suite resolve emits { include: [...] } in --json mode, exiting 0 for eligible/deferred/ignored, 2 for schema or unknown --domain errors, and 3 for blocked probes or branch mismatches.
App daemon shCopy loopwright app-serve --config github-app.yaml --repo . --json Requires spec.listen.enabled: true (exit 2 when disabled or invalid; 130/143 on SIGINT/SIGTERM). See GitHub App .
Runner and evolution Hardware runner shCopy loopwright runner relay --config relay.yaml --json loopwright runner worker --config worker.yaml --once --json runner relay isolates controller HMAC secrets from worker tokens, enforces leaseEpoch fencing, and streams 1 MiB CAS artifacts so private GPU workers open zero inbound ports. Workers compile Stage A without held_out_workloads and execute Stage B read-only with networkMode: none.
Evolution campaigns shCopy loopwright evolve check --campaign campaign.yaml --repo . --json loopwright evolve run --campaign campaign.yaml --state ../campaign-state --repo . --json loopwright evolve status --campaign ../campaign-state --json loopwright evolve inspect --campaign ../campaign-state --island 0 --json loopwright evolve resume --campaign ../campaign-state --repo . --json loopwright evolve export --campaign ../campaign-state --out ../bundle --format oci-layout --json Keep --state strictly outside --repo (EVOLUTION_SCHEMA_INVALID, exit 2 otherwise). evolve export verifies every HMAC verdict receipt fail-closed (EXPORT_UNVERIFIED_FORBIDDEN, exit 3) and refuses synthetic_fixture receipts without --allow-synthetic-probe.
Environment variable Purpose LOOPWRIGHT_BENCHMARK_GATE_URL Fallback HTTPS or loopback benchmark-gate.v1 URL for runner relay LOOPWRIGHT_GATE_SIGNING_SECRET Required HMAC secret for benchmark submission and fail-closed evolve export LOOPWRIGHT_GATE_AUTH_TOKEN Optional bearer token bound to authCredentialRef on remote relays LOOPWRIGHT_MODELS_JSON Optional Pi models.json path for custom providers and endpoints Exit codes Code Meaning 0 Completed, no change, successful static command, or suite eligible/deferred/ignored 2 Usage, configuration, unknown --domain, or manifest rejected 3 Unsupported capability, blocked work, TEAM_ENVELOPE_VIOLATION, or EXPORT_UNVERIFIED_FORBIDDEN 4 Execution, acceptance, DIGEST_LOCKFILE_DRIFT, or artifact validation failed 5 Allowance or campaign budget exhausted 6 Deadline expired 7 Reconciliation, EVOLUTION_CONFLICT, lease fenced (QUEUE_LEASE_FENCED), or clock drift 8 Authoritative result unavailable, incident, store corruption, or runner teardown failure 130 / 143 Cancellation, pause, or accounted SIGINT / SIGTERM (subject to uncertainty precedence) See also — Coding Agents (zero-secret loopwright step loops) · Installation (CLI install and bootstrap prompts) · Controller and Registry (trusted execution bindings)

content:
Coding Agents Drive bounded Loopwright runs from OAuth or subscription coding agents without GitHub Actions, GitHub Apps, or provider API keys. Host sessions in Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Cursor, Orca, or Pi pull leased turns via loopwright step.
Install the loopwright CLI first via Installation . Keep --run-root outside --repo and export verified overlays with loopwright inspect before committing local branch changes.
Contents Operating model Skill and prompt Step 1: Pull assignment Step 2: Execute role Step 3: Submit lease Multi-role routing Step 4: Apply overlay Recovery and exits Operating model Delegated stepping turns Loopwright into a pull-based local coroutine (loopwright step next | submit | cancel). Your host coding agent supplies model execution over its OAuth or subscription session, while Loopwright enforces SQLite lease fencing, workspace confinement, and independent verification.
Zero Loopwright provider credentials, GitHub App keys, or workflow secrets are needed on disk or in environment variables:
Operating mode Entry flags Role compilation Declarative Taskpack --taskpack .loopwright/taskpack.yaml Compiles roles as adapter: delegated with publication.mode: disabled Managed Controller --config, --registry, --registry-sha256 Uses adapter: delegated profiles with local publication.mode: disabled Skill and prompt Portable skill Install the standalone loopwright-step skill into your project or user skill directory:
shCopy npx skills add gpustack/loopwright --skill loopwright-step Or copy .agents/skills/loopwright-step/SKILL.md into .agents/skills/loopwright-step/SKILL.md (repo scope) or ~/.agents/skills/loopwright-step/SKILL.md (user scope).
Zero-install prompt When running without local skills installed, paste this prompt into your coding agent inside the target checkout:
textCopy Read https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/llms.txt and fetch https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/latest/docs/operations/coding-agents/index.md. Drive this repository through loopwright step next and loopwright step submit using a disjoint --run-root directory outside the checkout, keep all edits confined to candidateDir, and once result.json settles completed, export a fresh inspect bundle to a new child path and apply candidate.files.json onto my current Git branch. Step 1: Pull assignment Choose a canonical --run-root strictly disjoint from --repo with zero symlink components (resolve pwd -P on macOS). Start a Declarative Taskpack run (native spec.preflight, --baseline-alignment, --source-revision, and --allow-privileged are supported):
shCopy RUN_ROOT="$(cd "$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/loopwright-run.XXXXXX")" && pwd -P)" RUN_ID="local-sync-01" loopwright step next \ --taskpack .loopwright/taskpack.yaml \ --repo . \ --run-root "$RUN_ROOT" \ --run-id "$RUN_ID" \ --json For Managed Controller runs, pin target.sourceRevision to git rev-parse HEAD and pass --config, --registry, and --registry-sha256. With --json, stdout emits NDJSON Envelope lines; when kind is "step", data returns the StepYield assignment (candidateDir, contextFiles, selection, allowedTools, scope, prompt, submissionPath, and single-use leaseToken).
Step 2: Execute role Execute the yielded prompt inside candidateDir while obeying four confinement invariants:
Isolated staging: Modify files only inside candidateDir; leave --repo and <runRoot>/<runId> untouched. Regular files only: Create zero symlinks (O_NOFOLLOW), zero hardlinks (nlink === 1), and zero .git entries. Overlay bounds: Stay within spec.limits.overlay (default 128 files / 4 MiB, up to 16,384 files / 16 GiB via CAS streaming). Protected & read-only invariance: Never edit 0o400/0o500 protected paths, .git, <controlRoot>, or candidateDir during repair === "format" or read-only review turns. Step 3: Submit lease Submit the completed turn with its single-use leaseToken (add --submission-file, --status no_change|failed|blocked, or --reason when needed):
shCopy loopwright step submit \ --run-root "$RUN_ROOT" \ --run-id "$RUN_ID" \ --lease "$LEASE_TOKEN" \ --status completed \ --json Loopwright captures the overlay, runs independent checks (scope.v1, json-artifact.v1, no-change.v1, and local command.v1), and emits either the next StepYield or a terminal result/incident envelope. Pre-commit scan failures release authority without consuming leaseToken or deleting candidateDir so you can fix and re-submit.
Multi-role routing Declare 1..4 ordered roles under spec.roles in .loopwright/taskpack.yaml to run multi-agent DAGs such as author-then-reviewer pipelines. step next --taskpack compiles every role as adapter: delegated automatically.
Taskpack yamlCopy apiVersion: loopwright.dev/v1alpha1 kind: Taskpack metadata: name: multi-role-sync spec: goal: candidate: Refresh version manifests from upstream releases and pass every local check. noChange: Confirm tracked manifests match upstream releases and settle as no change. scope: writable: - docs - versions.json protected: - policy/invariants.md roles: # Optional 1..4 roles compiled as delegated during step next - id: author purpose: task provider: anthropic model: claude-sonnet-4-6 thinking: high # Optional tools: # Optional - read - write - edit - bash - id: review purpose: review provider: openai model: gpt-5.4 thinking: high # Optional tools: # Optional - read dependsOn: # Optional - author upstreams: - id: engine kind: github-release source: gpustack/engine watchedPaths: - docs proposal: path: docs/proposal.json requiredFields: - schema_version - summary schemaVersion: 1 verification: localChecks: - id: proposal-json implementation: json-artifact.v1 externalGates: [] publication: mode: pull_request targetBranch: main headBranchPrefix: auto-sync/ titleTemplate: "chore(sync) - update upstream manifests" memory: directory: .loopwright/memory/multi-role-sync apply: separate-pull-request onNoModelBudget: deterministic-observations-only triggers: schedule: false workflowDispatch: true releasePublished: false commentCommands: [] Override role models at admission without editing YAML via repeatable --role-model <roleId>=<provider>/<model>[:<thinking>] flags (up to 8 roles, persisted in run.json), then dispatch each yielded selection to a matching subagent or worker:
shCopy loopwright step next \ --taskpack .loopwright/taskpack.yaml \ --repo . \ --run-root "$RUN_ROOT" \ --run-id "$RUN_ID" \ --role-model author=anthropic/claude-opus-4-6:high \ --role-model review=openai-codex/gpt-5.4:high \ --json Step 4: Apply overlay Terminal step submit deletes <runRoot>/workspaces/<runId> while keeping verified artifacts under <runRoot>/<runId>. Once result.json settles completed, export a fresh bundle to a new --output path (0700):
shCopy INSPECT_DIR="$(cd "$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/loopwright-inspect.XXXXXX")" && pwd -P)/bundle" loopwright inspect --run-root "$RUN_ROOT" --run-id "$RUN_ID" --output "$INSPECT_DIR" --json Before applying $INSPECT_DIR/candidate.files.json onto your branch (either via the loopwright-step skill or an atomic script), verify five invariants:
Completed lock: $INSPECT_DIR/result.json settled completed and matches task.lock.json lockHash. Clean baseline: Local git status --porcelain is empty and HEAD equals pinned sourceRevision (and baseTree.commitOid for overlays). Safe targets: Every path is repo-relative with zero symlinks, zero hardlinks (nlink === 1), and zero .git segments. Verified CAS blobs: Every version: 2 entry (cas://sha256/<hex>) matches its 1 MiB streamed SHA-256 and 100644/100755 mode. Review diff: Inspect git status and git diff, run project tests, and commit on your branch. Recovery and exits Rotate a lost lease after a worker crash, or cancel cleanly (exit 130):
shCopy loopwright step next --run-root "$RUN_ROOT" --run-id "$RUN_ID" --reissue-lease --json loopwright step cancel --run-root "$RUN_ROOT" --run-id "$RUN_ID" --json Exit code Diagnostic or outcome 0 Yielded awaiting_role, or settled completed / no_change 2 / 3 Schema or --run-root overlap (2); blocked or CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED (3) 4 / 5 / 6 Verification failed (4), budget exhausted (5), or DEADLINE (6) 7 OWNER_BUSY, AUTHORITY_REFUSED, or RECOVERY_REQUIRED 8 / 130 / 143 Artifact/store incident (8), step cancel/SIGINT (130), or SIGTERM (143) See also — CLI (local operator subcommands and flags) · Taskpack (manifest roles, scope, and checks) · Controller and Registry (delegated role profiles)

content:
GitHub Action The reusable Action runs a taskpack cycle in a consumer repository without a resident server. It executes optional host preflight, discovers upstream changes, verifies candidates, and can publish a managed pull request.
Contents Workflow Execution and publication Secrets and environment Core inputs Outputs Triggers Workflow Install a taskpack and configure provider and App secrets before enabling this workflow. The App installation needs repository contents and pull request write permissions for native publication.
yamlCopy name: loopwright on: schedule: - cron: '0 3 * * *' workflow_dispatch: {} issue_comment: types: - created permissions: contents: read jobs: taskpack: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 with: fetch-depth: 0 persist-credentials: false - uses: gpustack/loopwright@main id: loopwright with: taskpack-path: .loopwright/taskpack.yaml # Optional suite-path: .loopwright/suite.yaml # Optional multi-domain suite domain: docs # Optional suite domain ID resolve-suite-only: 'false' # Optional matrix resolution only mode: auto # Optional (auto, candidate, or no-change) allow-privileged-execution: 'false' # Optional dual-key host unlock allow-workflow-writes: 'false' # Optional dual-key workflow write unlock event-name: ${{ github.event_name }} event-path: ${{ github.event_path }} github-app-id: ${{ secrets.LOOPWRIGHT_APP_ID }} github-app-private-key: ${{ secrets.LOOPWRIGHT_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }} output: json,github-step-summary # Optional env: ZAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ZAI_API_KEY }} Mode auto: Runs preflight or upstream discovery, dispatches candidate on changes, or settles no-change without model calls. Suite matrix: Pass suite-path with resolve-suite-only: 'true' to emit outputs.matrix, then run each job with domain. Dual-key authority: Privileged capabilities require allow-privileged-execution: 'true'; workflow edits require allow-workflow-writes: 'true'; host mounts require allow-host-mounts. Provider: Set the token environment variable expected by the model selected in spec.models. Runtime: The Action provisions Node.js 26 and builds the workspace if its entrypoint is absent. Execution and publication Live runs enforce policyProfile: github, validate spec.triggers before spec.preflight, authorize the actor, initialize SecretScrubber, and compile artifacts outside the checkout.
Stage Behavior Preflight Validates spec.triggers (and suite-path probes) first, then runs spec.preflight.script post-auth Align Runs isolated 3-way git merge-tree when sourceRevision !== baseRevision (fail-fast or extract-context) Discover Resolves upstreams, lockstep held_back holds, or upstream-records; routes settled auto runs to no-change Execute Authors candidates in sandboxes with CAS pointers and runs local or external checks with bounded repair Publish Streams verified CAS blobs into a head-pinned managed PR with DCO sign-off and --force-with-lease Pass source-revision when preflight stages writable files onto a commit separate from GITHUB_SHA. Uncertain external outcomes stay unknown and are never retried silently.
Memory finalization follows spec.memory.apply (separate-pull-request, inline-with-candidate, local-only, or disabled) without blocking primary task completion. On GitHub-hosted runners (RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT=github-hosted), an omitted spec.sandbox selects direct-dedicated; self-hosted runners negotiate host OS sandboxes instead (see Sandbox Backends ).
Protected paths override writable paths. .github/workflows/** stays write-protected unless both allowWorkflowWrites: true and allow-workflow-writes: 'true' are set.
Secrets and environment Pass github-token, or pass github-app-id and github-app-private-key to mint an installation token. Precedence is explicit github-token > App credentials > ambient GITHUB_TOKEN (GH_TOKEN is not the Action fallback).
Credential Purpose github-token or GITHUB_TOKEN GitHub discovery, opted-in checks, and native PR publication github-app-id, github-app-private-key Mint repository installation token (github-app-installation-id auto-discovers) Provider token env var Authenticate live model calls (supports comma-separated token pools) LOOPWRIGHT_GATE_SIGNING_SECRET Sign external gate.v1 requests when a remote gate endpoint is used LOOPWRIGHT_PUBLICATION_SIGNING_SECRET Sign external publication endpoint requests Local command.v1 gates and native publication use ephemeral loopback credentials and need no external signing secrets.
Core inputs All Action inputs are optional. Precedence is Action with: inputs > taskpack.yaml spec.limits > LOOPWRIGHT_* env vars > compiler defaults.
Input Default Purpose taskpack-path / suite-path .loopwright/taskpack.yaml / unset Manifest or multi-domain TaskpackSuite path domain / resolve-suite-only Unset / false Target suite domain or emit outputs.matrix only mode / baseline-alignment candidate / off auto|candidate|no-change and 3-way conflict policy dry-run / force false / false Compile statically without execution, or bypass no_change/dedupe event-name / event-path workflow_dispatch / unset Pass github.event_name and github.event_path for trigger checks source-revision / upstream-records GITHUB_SHA / unset Detached candidate base ref or precomputed upstream JSON allow-privileged-execution false Dual-key unlock for privileged execution capabilities allow-workflow-writes / allow-host-mounts false / unset Dual-key .github/workflows/** write unlock and host mount allowlist provider, model, thinking, api, base-url Taskpack model pool Model, reasoning level, wire API, and gateway overrides wall-time-seconds, total-tokens, max-attempts 3600, 20000000, 5 Execution limit overrides (see Taskpack ) Outputs The Action writes a scrubbed result JSON summary to stdout and GITHUB_OUTPUT, and streams [loopwright] progress lines to stderr. A compiled result alone does not establish publication; inspect delegateOutcome.
Output Meaning result Compact structured summary and delegateOutcome (ok, detail) pr-url Published PR URL when available; otherwise empty memory-pr-url Separate memory PR URL when published or updated; otherwise empty total-tokens Exact integer token subtotal, or 0 when usage is unavailable cost-usd Six-decimal USD subtotal when provenance is reported or estimated matrix Deterministic JSON matrix ({ include: [...] }) when suite-path resolves Extended formats (json, github-step-summary, markdown, text) append a sanitized Run Health (RunEval) section with toolRepeats, pingPong, repairConvergence, and autoApplied: false hints. Missing cost is unknown, not zero.
Triggers Intake enforces spec.triggers strictly before spec.preflight or execution. Omitted or disabled triggers reject schedule, workflow_dispatch, release, repository_dispatch, and comment events fail-closed.
Install a workflow in each consumer repository. For centralized webhook intake and token brokering, see GitHub App .
See also — GitHub App (configure webhook intake) · Sandbox Backends (select execution isolation) · Taskpack (manifest schema and limits)

content:
GitHub App GitHub Action mode is the primary zero-server path for consumer repositories. Use gpustack/loopwright@main for scheduled runs, manual dispatch, and /loopwright comment commands.
The resident HTTP daemon is disabled by default. Operators can opt in for centralized webhook queuing and token brokering; production requires separately qualified ingress and host infrastructure.
Contents App registration Admission and permissions GitHubAppConfig Control plane Host qualification App registration Create a GitHub App in your personal Developer settings or organization settings (https://github.com/organizations/<org>/settings/apps), then install it on the target repositories.
Setting Value Contents Read and write Pull requests Read and write Issues Read and write Metadata Read-only Webhooks Inactive for Action mode; active for app-serve Events For app-serve: Issue comment, Pull request review, Release App secrets Repository or organization secrets: LOOPWRIGHT_APP_ID, LOOPWRIGHT_APP_PRIVATE_KEY Webhook secret LOOPWRIGHT_WEBHOOK_SECRET when app-serve is enabled Use actions/create-github-app-token@v1 with gpustack/loopwright@main in the consumer workflow . Supply the App webhook secret and private key in the trusted daemon environment when app-serve is enabled.
Admission and permissions Subscribe only to the event types used by your taskpack. Comment commands require authorized actors. The receiver verifies X-Hub-Signature-256 over raw request bytes with HMAC-SHA256 and fails closed on mismatches or conflicting delivery IDs.
Installation tokens are restricted to one repository. The read_only profile grants contents and metadata read; publish_pull_request grants contents and pull requests write plus metadata read.
GitHubAppConfig Save the daemon configuration as github-app.yaml (<= 64 KiB):
yamlCopy apiVersion: loopwright.dev/v1alpha1 kind: GitHubAppConfig spec: appId: '12345' webhookSecretEnv: LOOPWRIGHT_WEBHOOK_SECRET privateKeyEnv: LOOPWRIGHT_APP_PRIVATE_KEY apiBaseUrl: https://api.github.com # Optional (defaults to https://api.github.com) listen: # Optional block (set enabled to true for loopwright app-serve) enabled: false # Optional (defaults to false) host: 127.0.0.1 port: 8787 webhookPath: /webhooks/github # Optional (defaults to /webhooks/github) tokenTtlSeconds: 600 # Optional (60..3600, defaults to 600) maxPayloadBytes: 1048576 # Optional (1024..26214400, defaults to 1048576) taskpackPath: .loopwright/taskpack.yaml # Optional repo-relative taskpack path suitePath: .loopwright/suite.yaml # Optional mutually exclusive with taskpackPath operatorAllowlist: # Optional 1..64 GitHub logins for slash commands - release-operator Secrets: Name uppercase environment variables ([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*), never raw secret values. Listen: Set listen.enabled: true with host and port, and place authenticated ingress in front of external webhooks. Manifest path: taskpackPath and suitePath must be repo-relative regular files and are mutually exclusive. Route isolation: webhookPath must start with / and cannot collide with /healthz or /tenants/*. Control plane Set spec.listen.enabled: true, bind the named secrets in the trusted environment, then start the daemon:
shCopy loopwright app-serve --config github-app.yaml --repo . The daemon binds loopback by default and exposes listen.webhookPath (default /webhooks/github), /healthz, and private tenant lease/settle routes. The broker issues scoped short-lived tokens and scrubs secrets from responses.
With spec.suitePath, one verified X-GitHub-Delivery fans out across matching domains while deduplicating redeliveries, enforcing the suite protected union, and binding each domain manifest SHA-256. For issue_comment webhooks lacking PR branch metadata, intake queries spec.apiBaseUrl to verify same-repo ownership before admission.
Webhook events Event Trigger surface Admission rule release Published upstream release Enabled via spec.triggers.releasePublished issue_comment Issue or PR /loopwright command Requires collaborator or operatorAllowlist actor pull_request_review Managed PR review comment Requires authorized actor and enabled command schedule Cron workflow run Enabled via spec.triggers.schedule workflow_dispatch Manual operator trigger Enabled via spec.triggers.workflowDispatch repository_dispatch Automation dispatch payload Subject to intake signature and trigger policy Intake dispositions Disposition Queue action Meaning ready Enqueued for tenant Signature, actor, and trigger checks passed no_change Settled without run Upstream discovery found no eligible change blocked Rejected before run Policy, authorization, or payload check refused intake Host qualification Verify the host against the runtime baseline and required sandbox backends before starting app-serve. Interactive MCP OAuth challenges and unsandboxed fallbacks fail closed (MCP_OAUTH_UNSUPPORTED, SANDBOX_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE, SANDBOX_CAPABILITY_INSUFFICIENT).
In-memory queue and delivery state do not establish durable cross-restart recovery.

content:
Declarative Taskpack Declarative taskpack mode is Loopwright’s automated workflow for repository maintainers and local CLI operators. Author one .loopwright/taskpack.yaml file in your repository, and loopwright run --taskpack, loopwright step, or the GitHub Action compiles contracts, handler digests, preflight stages, and credential bindings automatically.
For out-of-repo TrustedRegistry governance or manual CLI controller configs, follow Managed Controller instead.
Contents Overview Prompt bootstrap Step 1: Author taskpack Step 2: Validate taskpack Step 3: Configure workflow Step 4: Review outcomes Overview Declarative taskpack mode eliminates boilerplate while preserving every Loopwright safety boundary:
Responsibility Authored in taskpack Compiled by Loopwright Work scope Explicit dir/**, exact files, or */? globs Adds control paths, scripts, and built-in masks; protected wins Execution spec.execution, spec.preflight, upstreams, proposal Runs preflight post-auth and compiles 0600 runtime configs Digests Optional digests.pinDigests (digests.lock.json) Computes SHA-256 digests for handlers, check dirs, and instructions Secrets Pass GitHub Secrets to Action or App env Generates scoped ${ENV} bindings and scrubs logs Settlement Choose pull_request or disabled Opens head-pinned PRs or settles check-only no_change runs Prompt bootstrap loopwright init scaffolds low-level controller drafts and does not inspect your repository. To run an interview-first setup or migrate an existing sync workflow, paste this prompt into your coding agent inside the target repository:
textCopy Read https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/llms.txt and its Bootstrap Interview Reference (https://docs.gpustack.ai/loopwright/references/bootstrap-interview.md). Inspect this repository first WITHOUT editing any files yet, then interview me one question at a time with repository-grounded defaults to agree on which modules to automate or exclude, domain boundaries, update cadence, version/promotion holds, bounded host preflight -> offline sandbox -> independent verifier design, model pool (LOOPWRIGHT_PROVIDER_TOKEN), and workflow panel. Wait for my approval on the design summary before generating Loopwright config (apiVersion: loopwright.dev/v1alpha1) and running dry-run verification. The agent scans your repository, interviews you one question at a time, waits for summary approval, and writes taskpacks, TaskpackSuite manifests (for multi-domain repos), bounded verifiers, and workflows.
Step 1: Author taskpack Create .loopwright/taskpack.yaml in the target repository (Loopwright derives .loopwright as the control root; pass --taskpack <dir>/taskpack.yaml for a custom root):
yamlCopy apiVersion: loopwright.dev/v1alpha1 kind: Taskpack metadata: name: docs-sync spec: goal: candidate: Refresh documentation from upstream releases and pass local checks. noChange: Confirm upstream documentation needs no update and settle as no change. execution: # Optional trust mode and lockfile pinning mode: strict # Optional (defaults to strict) digests: pinDigests: true preflight: # Optional post-auth host preflight hook script: scripts/prepare-docs-sync.mjs timeoutSeconds: 120 # Optional scope: # Optional writable: - docs/** protected: - docs/protected-notes.md - scripts/** upstreams: - id: engine kind: github-release source: octocat/engine watchedPaths: - docs proposal: # Optional structured proposal ledger path: docs/proposal.json requiredFields: - schema_version - candidates schemaVersion: 1 verification: localChecks: - id: docs-proposal-json implementation: json-artifact.v1 - id: verify-docs implementation: command.v1 parameters: script: .loopwright/checks/verify.sh timeoutSeconds: 30 # Optional externalGates: [] # Optional publication: mode: pull_request targetBranch: main headBranchPrefix: loopwright-docs- titleTemplate: "docs - sync upstream documentation" memory: directory: .loopwright/memory/docs-sync apply: separate-pull-request onNoModelBudget: deterministic-observations-only triggers: schedule: true workflowDispatch: true releasePublished: false commentCommands: - retry - revise - status models: # Optional ordered model pool - provider: zai id: glm-5.3 thinking: high # Optional apiKeyEnv: ZAI_API_KEY # Optional Field reference: See Taskpack for roles, steps, decisions, sandbox, and TaskpackSuite. Local manifests: Local CLI runs (run --taskpack and step) can omit triggers, publication, and memory. Protected inputs: Place instructions, preflight.script, and command.v1 scripts under protected paths. Zero embedded secrets: Never put tokens or ${ENV} templates in taskpack.yaml; use spec.vars for static non-secret values. Delegated role DAG Add spec.roles (author + read-only review) and optional spec.steps to run zero-secret local step loops (see Taskpack and Coding Agents ):
shCopy loopwright step next --taskpack .loopwright/taskpack.yaml --repo . --run-root ../runs --run-id demo-1 --json loopwright step submit --run-root ../runs --run-id demo-1 --lease TOKEN --status completed --json Step 2: Validate taskpack Confirm the runtime baseline , sync digests.lock.json when pinDigests: true, and dry-run locally before enabling Actions:
shCopy loopwright digest sync --taskpack .loopwright/taskpack.yaml --repo . loopwright digest sync --taskpack .loopwright/taskpack.yaml --repo . --check --json loopwright run --taskpack .loopwright/taskpack.yaml --repo . --dry-run --json loopwright run --taskpack .loopwright/taskpack.yaml --repo . --run-root ../runs --run-id demo-1 --json --dry-run validates the manifest, verifies digests.lock.json, negotiates sandboxes, and compiles artifacts without running preflight, models, or pushes.
Step 3: Configure workflow Add .github/workflows/loopwright.yml to run on schedule, workflow_dispatch, or /loopwright comments with mode: auto:
yamlCopy name: Loopwright Sync on: schedule: - cron: '0 4 * * *' workflow_dispatch: issue_comment: types: - created permissions: contents: read jobs: sync: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 with: fetch-depth: 0 persist-credentials: false - uses: gpustack/loopwright@main with: taskpack-path: .loopwright/taskpack.yaml # Optional mode: auto # Optional github-app-id: ${{ secrets.LOOPWRIGHT_APP_ID }} github-app-private-key: ${{ secrets.LOOPWRIGHT_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }} event-name: ${{ github.event_name }} event-path: ${{ github.event_path }} dry-run: 'false' # Optional env: ZAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ZAI_API_KEY }} Bootstrap provenance Trusted checkout: Check out refs/heads/main with persist-credentials: false, gate issue_comment to authorized collaborators, and fetch +refs/pull/<number>/head without checking out untrusted PR heads. Commit SHA pinning: Pin third-party Actions and gpustack/loopwright to 40-character commit SHAs instead of uses: ./ during self-upgrades so candidate branches cannot replace control-plane code. Step 4: Review outcomes Candidate pull request: Opens or updates a head-pinned PR matching headBranchPrefix after all checks pass. Verified no-change: Runs check-only no-change.v1 verification without model calls when mode: auto finds no change. Slash-command iteration: Authorized collaborators comment /loopwright status, retry, or revise. Reviewed memory: Persists active entries under <controlRoot>/memory/<name> per spec.memory.apply without blocking task completion. See also — Taskpack (manifest schema, limits, and TaskpackSuite) · Managed Controller (out-of-repo contract and registry workflow)
